OFFICIAL SYLLABUS

Unit IV scope from the course handout

Polymers – types of polymers, commodity and engineering polymers; properties and applications of PE, PP, PS, PVC, PMMA, PET, PC, PA, ABS, PAI, PPO, PPS, PEEK and PTFE; thermoset polymers – urea- and phenol-formaldehydes; nylon; engineering ceramics – properties and applications of Al₂O₃, SiC, Si₃N₄, PSZ and SIALON; intermetallics; composites – matrix and reinforcement materials; applications of composites and nanocomposites.

STUDY CHECKLIST

Topics listed in the academic calendar

Use this checklist with the Unit IV student-notes PDF. It follows the topic sequence in the course handout.

  • Polymer classification, structure and engineering significance
  • PE, PP, PS and PVC
  • PMMA, PET, PC, PA and ABS
  • PAI, PPO, PPS, PEEK and PTFE
  • Urea-formaldehyde and phenol-formaldehyde thermosets
  • Engineering ceramics: Al₂O₃, SiC and Si₃N₄
  • PSZ, SIALON and intermetallics
  • Composite matrix and reinforcement materials
  • Applications of composites and nanocomposites
